Also, it is proved that a backcrossing algebra is a plenary train algebra of rank \(m\) if and only if, it is a principal train one of rank \(m\).

For a given baric algebra which satisfies the identity to be backcrossing algebra proven that a) algebra will be a principal train algebra of rank \(n\) with the corresponding principal train roots; b) Algebra will be a plenary train algebra of rank \(n\) with the corresponding plenary train roots.

It is proved that any element of the backcrossing (baric) algebra which has weight one is idempotent element of the algebra.

For the backcrossing train algebras, authors confirm a first conjecture of Juan Carlos Gutiérrez Fernández on the relation between plenary train roots and principal train roots.

Given the main condition of containing an idempotent for the backcrossing algebra which is a principal train algebra of rank \(n\).
